changelog:
• Firefox Mobile UI Overhaul: Clean speed-dial grid with large circular brand tiles (Google, YouTube, Amazon, Wikipedia, Instagram, Reddit, X, Spotify, and Add Shortcut), floating pill search bar, and centered You're Protected status chip.
• YouTube Zero-Delay Engine: Completely eliminated black screen stall before videos start by blocking ad endpoints at network level and removing decoder buffer seeks.
• Minimize & PiP Freeze Fix: Resolved video stall/layout locking when minimizing or returning to the browser.
• Multi-Platform Video Downloader: Fixed video stream detection with DOM-level fallback and instant download helpers across Instagram, X, Reddit, and YouTube.
• Outside-of-App Social Ad Blockers: Upgraded accessibility engine with dynamic package binding, ALL_MASK events, and smooth gestures to auto-scroll promoted content on Instagram, X, and Reddit.
